title: The totals row is labeled "Total" in the Part # cell, leaves the per-unit and identity cells blank, and pins its bold Total Cost far right
permissions_required: A role with the existing inventory-reports permission (Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Inventory Value report is open with rows loaded and all columns turned on.
steps: 1. Look at the row at the bottom of the report.
2. Read its Part # cell, its Description/Category/Vendor cells, and its Unit Cost/Unit Sell cells.
3. Look at its Total Cost cell and compare the number formats to the data rows.
expected: 1. A totals row is shown at the bottom, with the literal label "Total" in the Part # column's cell.
2. The Description, Category, and Vendor cells are blank; the Unit Cost and Unit Sell cells are blank (a per-unit price has no meaningful sum).
3. The totals-row Total Cost cell is pinned far right and bold, matching the column, and the row uses the same number formats as the data rows.
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
spec_ref: specs/inventory-value.md Story 4 S4-R1; S4-R4; S4-R5; S4-R6; S4-R7
notes: On screen the label is "Total" (S4-R1) while the DOWNLOADED totals row is labeled "Totals" (S10-R6) — the spec states both explicitly; VIU-confirm and flag to the owner if the build differs.
